### 1.6 Data preparation for LCA

```{r, include = F}
# var$var.type, 3 types: binary, categorical, ordinal

#recode for LCA, recode those that are actually binary but has characters (string) (or not numeric) to (0,1)

con.var <- const[str_detect(var.type, "continuous|ordinal"), var.name]
cat.var <- const[var.type %like% 'categorical', var.name]
bin.var <- const[var.type %like% 'binary', var.name]
catbin.var <- const[str_detect(var.type, "categorical|binary"), var.name]

# Subset to only relevant for lca and compete cases
dhs.seg <- dhs.seg[, c(pca.var, "caseid"), with = F]
dhs.seg <- drop_na(dhs.seg)

```

```{r, include = F}

# make a reformatted version

## For ordinal re-categorize to start at 1

}

}

## setting nominal (categorical) to be coded as 1,2, (here they are all character, no factor...

## setting nominal to be coded as 1,2,...
```

## 2. LCA  

### 2.1. Model, statistics, distribution

```{r}

if(rerun_model == T){

  f <- as.formula(paste0("cbind(", paste(pca.var, collapse = ", "), ")~1"))
  

class_comp <- data.frame('k' = starting_kClass:ending_kClass, 'BIC' = numeric(num_kClasses), 'AIC' = numeric(num_kClasses), 'Chisq' = numeric(num_kClasses), 'llh' = numeric(num_kClasses), 'iter' = numeric(num_kClasses), post.prob = numeric(num_kClasses) ) #'converged' = logical(9))
pred_class <- list()

lca_results <- list()


for (i in 1:num_kClasses) {

  mod.i <- (starting_kClass:ending_kClass)[i]

  cat("\nRunning model with", mod.i, "classes...\n")

  #when knitting partially run models, comment out from here
  res.all <- tryCatch({
    dir.create(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models/k", mod.i)), recursive = T, showWarnings = F)

    res.all <- lapply(1:nreps, function(j){
        res.j <- poLCA(f, dhs.seg_reform, nclass = (mod.i), maxiter = 5000, tol = 1e-7, nrep = 1, verbose = FALSE)
        saveRDS(res.j, file.path(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models//k",mod.i, "/res_", j, ".rds" ))))

        return(res.j)
      })



  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("An error occurred: ", e$message, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  })

  saveRDS(res.all, file.path(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models//k",mod.i, "/res.all_templist", ".rds" ))))

    lliks <- unlist(lapply(1:nreps, function(x){round(res.all[[x]]$llik,1)}))

    max_llik.mod <- which.max(lliks)[1]
    mod_llik.mod <- which(lliks == mfv(lliks)[max(length(mfv(lliks)))])[1]

    saveRDS(res.all[[max_llik.mod]], file.path(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models//k",mod.i, "/res_max", ".rds" ))))
        saveRDS(res.all[[mod_llik.mod]], file.path(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models//k",mod.i, "/res_mod", ".rds" ))))


   res <- res.all[[max_llik.mod]]
   lca_results[[i]] <- res.all[[max_llik.mod]]

     # when knitting partially run models, uncomment out below 

    #   res <- readRDS(file.path(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models//k",mod.i, "/res_max", ".rds" ))))
    # 
    # lca_results[[i]] <- res


  if (is.null(res)) {
    cat("The poLCA function did not return results for", mod.i, "classes.\n")
    class_comp[class_comp$k == (mod.i), ] <- c((mod.i), NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, NA, FALSE)
    next
  }
   
  # posterior prob
  res_posterior <- as.data.frame(res$posterior) %>%
    cbind(pred_class=res$predclass) %>%
    mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
    reshape2::melt(id.vars=c("id", "pred_class"), variable.name="cluster", value.name = "prob") %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(max_prob = max(prob)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(prob == max_prob) %>%
    group_by() %>%
    dplyr::summarize(avg_prob = mean(prob))
   
  class_comp[class_comp$k == (mod.i), ] <- c((mod.i), res$bic %||% NA, res$aic %||% NA, res$Chisq %||% NA, res$llik %||% NA, res$numiter %||% NA, res_posterior$avg_prob %||% NA)
  
  if (!is.null(res$predclass)) {
    dhs.seg$cluster <- res$predclass
    dhs.seg_reform$cluster <- res$predclass
    names(dhs.seg)[names(dhs.seg)=='cluster'] <- paste0('cluster_k',(mod.i))
    names(dhs.seg_reform)[names(dhs.seg_reform)=='cluster'] <- paste0('cluster_k',(mod.i))
  } else {
    warning("Model with", mod.i, "classes did not converge or there was another issue in obtaining class memberships.")
  }
}

saveRDS(class_comp, file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/", subset, "/class_comp.rds")))

saveRDS(lca_results, file.path(input_dir, "LCA/", subset, "/lca_results.rds" ))

saveRDS(dhs.seg, file=file.path(input_dir, "LCA/", subset, "/dhs.seg.rds"))

saveRDS(dhs.seg_reform, file = file.path(input_dir, "LCA/", subset, "/dhs.seg_reform.rds"))


} else{
  
  class_comp <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/", subset, "/class_comp.rds")))
  
  lca_results <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, "LCA/", subset, "/lca_results.rds" ))
  
  dhs.seg <- readRDS(file=file.path(input_dir, "LCA/", subset, "/dhs.seg.rds"))
  
  dhs.seg_reform<- readRDS(file=file.path(input_dir, "LCA/", subset, "/dhs.seg_reform.rds"))

}

```

### 2.2 Convergence 

#### Convergence stats, individual K models
```{r}
class_comp <- data.table(class_comp)
  
agg <- lapply(starting_kClass:ending_kClass, function(k.i){
  
  print(k.i)
  
  ki.mod.fits <- lapply(1:nreps, function(rep){
    
    mod <- readRDS(file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/",subset,"/sub_models//k", k.i, "/res_", rep, ".rds")))
    mod_posterior <- as.data.frame(mod$posterior) %>%
      cbind(pred_class=mod$predclass) %>%
      mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
      reshape2::melt(id.vars=c("id", "pred_class"), variable.name="cluster", value.name = "prob") %>%
      group_by(id) %>%
      mutate(max_prob = max(prob)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(prob == max_prob) %>%
      group_by() %>%
      dplyr::summarize(avg_prob = mean(prob))
    plot_dt <- cbind(dhs.seg, predclass = mod$predclass)
    plot_dt <- cbind(plot_dt, data.table(k = k.i, rep = rep, aic = mod$aic, bic = mod$bic, llik = mod$llik, post.prob = mod_posterior$avg_prob))

    return(plot_dt)
    
  }) %>% rbindlist(use.names = T)
  
  ki.mod.fits[, k_model := paste0("k", k)]

  ki.mod.fits <- ki.mod.fits[order(llik, rep)]
  
  ki.mod.fits[, order := .GRP, by = rep]
  
  counts <- ki.mod.fits[, .N, .(rep, predclass)]
  counts <- counts[order(rep, N)]
  counts[, relabel := seq_len(.N), by = rep]
  
  ki.mod.fits <- merge(ki.mod.fits, counts[,.(rep,predclass,relabel)])

  # Adjust likelihoods 
  ki.mod.fits[, llik := round(llik, 0)]
  
  max_llik = max(unique(ki.mod.fits$llik))
  n_llik = length(unique(ki.mod.fits$llik))
  min_llik = min(unique(ki.mod.fits$llik))
  mod_llik_n = length(mfv(ki.mod.fits$llik))
  
  if(mod_llik_n > 1){
    print("More than 1 mode")
    mod_llik <- max(mfv(ki.mod.fits$llik))
  } else{
    mod_llik = mfv(ki.mod.fits$llik, 0)
  }
  
  percent_mle =  sum(ki.mod.fits$llik == max_llik)/length(ki.mod.fits$llik)
  percent_mod =  sum(ki.mod.fits$llik == mod_llik)/length(ki.mod.fits$llik)
  max_llik.aic = max(unique(ki.mod.fits[llik == max_llik, round(aic, 0)]))
  max_llik.bic = max(unique(ki.mod.fits[llik == max_llik, round(bic, 0)]))
  max_llik.postprob = max(unique(ki.mod.fits[llik == max_llik, round(post.prob, 3)]))
  
  class_comp.i <- data.table(k = k.i, aic = max_llik.aic, bic = max_llik.bic, n_llik = n_llik, min_llik, max_llik, percent_mle, mod_llik_n, mod_llik, percent_mod, post.prob = max_llik.postprob)

  ki.mod.fits <- merge(ki.mod.fits, class_comp.i[, .(llik = mod_llik, mod_llik_model = TRUE)], all.x=T, by = "llik")
  ki.mod.fits[is.na(mod_llik_model), mod_llik_model := FALSE]
  
  ki.mod.fits <- merge(ki.mod.fits, class_comp.i[, .(llik = max_llik, max_llik_model = TRUE)], all.x=T, by = "llik")
  ki.mod.fits[is.na(max_llik_model), max_llik_model := FALSE]
  
  convergence_histograms.i <- 
    ggplot(unique(ki.mod.fits[k == k.i, .(k_model, rep, llik)])) + 
  geom_bar(aes(x = llik),color = "black", lwd=1) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  ggtitle(paste0("K-", k.i, " Log-Likelihoods"))  
  
  
  
convergence_tracking_plot.i <- ggplot(ki.mod.fits[k == k.i]) + 
    geom_bar(aes(x = order, fill = as.factor(relabel), color = mod_llik_model)) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c(F,T), values = c("white", "black")) + 
    facet_wrap(~k, ncol = 1) + 
    ggtitle(paste0("K-", k.i, " - Convergence of 100 reps"), subtitle = "Black outlined reps = modal likelihood") + xlab("Rep (ordered from min to max likelihood)") + 
  theme_bw() +  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  modal <- ki.mod.fits[mod_llik_model == TRUE & rep == ki.mod.fits[mod_llik_model == TRUE, min(rep)]]
  max <- ki.mod.fits[max_llik_model == TRUE & rep == ki.mod.fits[max_llik_model == TRUE, min(rep)]]

  sankey_data <- merge(modal[, .(caseid, mod_relabel = relabel)], max[, .(caseid, max_relabel = relabel)])

  links <- sankey_data[,.(value = .N),.(source = paste0("mod_", mod_relabel), 
                                       target = paste0("max_", max_relabel))]
     
 
  
    nodes <- data.frame(
      name=c(as.character(links$source), 
             as.character(links$target)) %>% unique()
    )
    
    # With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
    links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
    links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
    
    # Make the Network
    p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
                       Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
                       Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
                       sinksRight=FALSE)
  
  
    return(list(mod.fits = ki.mod.fits, 
                class_comp = class_comp.i,
                convergence_histograms.i = convergence_histograms.i,
                convergence_tracking_plot.i = convergence_tracking_plot.i,
                p = p))
  
}) #%>% rbindlist(use.names = T, fill = T)

ps <- lapply(1:length(agg), function(i){ return(agg[[i]]$p) } )
convergence_histograms <- lapply(1:length(agg), function(i){ return(agg[[i]]$convergence_histograms.i) } )
convergence_tracking_plots <- lapply(1:length(agg), function(i){ return(agg[[i]]$convergence_tracking_plot.i) } )

# Sankeys cannot print with for-loop, incopatibility with package?
# sorry, hardcoding for now

  if(i %in% 1:num_kClasses){
    convergence_histograms[[i]]
    convergence_tracking_plots[[i]]
    ps[[i]]
    
  }
  
}

print_sankey(3)
```

```{r, fig.width= 15, fig.height=25}
print(convergence_histograms)

mod.fits[, k_model := factor(k_model, levels = paste0("k", starting_kClass:ending_kClass), ordered = T)]

convergence_tracking_plot <- ggplot(mod.fits[]) + 
    geom_bar(aes(x = order, fill = as.factor(relabel), color = mod_llik_model)) +
    scale_color_manual(breaks = c(F,T), values = c("white", "black"), name = "Modal Likelihood Models") + 
    facet_wrap(~k, ncol = 1) + 
    ggtitle(paste0("Convergence of ", nreps, " reps"), subtitle = "Black outlined reps = modal likelihood") + xlab("Rep (ordered from min to max likelihood)") + 
  theme_bw() +  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(convergence_tracking_plot)

saveRDS(class_comp, file.path(input_dir, paste0("LCA/", subset, "/class_comp.rds")))
```

### 3.1  Heatmap (binary)

```{r}
# Define function
generate_heatmap <- function(data, cluster_var_name) {
  
  data_modified <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(c(bin.var), .data[[cluster_var_name]]) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(bin.var), ~ifelse(. == 2, 1, 0), .names = "prop_{.col}")) %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_var_name]]) %>%
    summarise(across(starts_with("prop_"), mean))
 
  
  df_long <- data_modified %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("prop_"), names_to = "var.label", values_to = "prop") 
  df_long <- data.table(df_long)
  df_long[, var.label := gsub(var.label, pattern = "^prop_", replacement = "")]

  
  df_long <- merge(df_long, const, by.x = "var.label", by.y = "f.var.name")
  
  
  # Plot
  heatmap <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = factor(.data[[cluster_var_name]]), y = var.name, fill = prop)) +
    geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(category), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#313695", mid = "#FFFFBF", high = "#A50026", midpoint = 0.5, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion within cluster", x = '', y = '', fill = 'Proportion within\ncluster') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 180, size = 5),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.8, "lines")) 
    
  return(heatmap)
}

# Define the cluster variables
cluster_vars <-  paste0("cluster_k", starting_kClass:ending_kClass)
heatmaps_list <- purrr::map(cluster_vars, ~ generate_heatmap(dhs.seg_reform, .x))

# To print each heatmap
purrr::walk(heatmaps_list, print)
```

```{r, fig.height = 25, fig.width=15, echo=F,include=T,results="asis"}
generate_stacked <- function(data, cluster_col) {

  long_dt <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(all_of(catbin.var), .data[[cluster_col]]) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(catbin.var), names_to = "variable", values_to = "level", values_transform = as.character)

  cluster_size <- long_dt %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_col]], variable) %>%
    summarize(cluster_total = n(), .groups = 'drop')

  agg_dt <- long_dt %>%
    group_by(.data[[cluster_col]], variable, level) %>%
    summarize(ct = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(cluster_size, by = c(cluster_col, "variable")) %>% 
    mutate(pct = round((ct/cluster_total)*100, 2)) %>% 
    mutate(var.label = ifelse(variable %in% names(custom_labels), 
                            custom_labels[variable], 
                            variable))

agg_dt <- merge(agg_dt, const, by.x = "variable", by.y = "f.var.name")

agg_group1 <- "Healthcare and mental models"
agg_dt1 <- agg_dt
agg_dt1 <- agg_dt1 %>% filter(variable %in% const[category == agg_group1, var.name])
plot_HC <- ggplot(agg_dt1, aes(x=var.label, y=pct, fill=level)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="stack",width=0.5) + 
  facet_grid(category ~ .data[[cluster_col]], scales = "free_y", space = "free_x", switch = "y") + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors) +
  labs(title = paste0("Distribution within ", agg_group1), x = "", y = "") +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Level")) +
  geom_text(aes(label=round(pct, 0)), position=position_stack(vjust=0.5), size=3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_flip()  +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"), 
        plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "cm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6) )
```

### 3.3  Sankey Diagram
```{r}

make_sankey <- function(data){
  links <- lapply(starting_kClass:(ending_kClass-1), function(i){
  
link.i<-  data[,.(value = .N),.(source = paste0("k", i, "_", get(paste0("cluster_k", i))), target = paste0("k", i+1, "_",get(paste0("cluster_k", i+1))))]
  
return(link.i)
}) %>% rbindlist(use.names = T, fill = T)



# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
  name=c(as.character(links$source), 
  as.character(links$target)) %>% unique()
)
 
# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
 
# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
              Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
              Value = "value", NodeID = "name", 
              sinksRight=FALSE,
                height = 500,
  width = 1000)
return(p)
}

sankey <- make_sankey(dhs.seg)

sankey

```
